sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Brajesh Kumar Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.
By means of the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.
303 of 2023 at Police Station-Shikohabad, District- Firozabad under Sections 498A, 304-B IPC and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act.
The applicant is in jail since 01.08.2023.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 27.09.2023.

The following arguments made by Brajesh Kumar Singh, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant,
which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Suchit Tandon, learned AGA from the record,
entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
1. The applicant is the father-in-law of the deceased.

1
2. The applicant never tortured the deceased nor did he demand dowry.
3. The deceased had some differences with her husband.
Prior to her death, she was staying with her parents continuously for a period of two months at her parental house.
4. The deceased was suffering from mental ailments.
She did not recover despite best medical care.
5. The body of the deceased was found near the railway track.
6. Prosecution evidence does not connect the applicant with the offence.
7. The prerequisite for attracting the presumption and the reversing the burden of proof are not established in the facts and circumstances and evidence of the case.
8. The applicant was falsely nominated only to blackmail the applicant and to extort money from him.
9. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from the instant case.
10. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to join the trial proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant- Ramhet be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
Order Date :- 16.1.2024
